# Open Environments Index

> 402 open RL environments for language-model agents, filed under the ISCED-F 2013 fields of education. By Renaissance Labs. Generated 2026-11-24.

## 00 Generic programmes and qualifications

- [Reverse-Text-RL](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/primeintellect-reverse-text-rl/) (0021 Literacy and numeracy; reward: exact match): Reverse a short sentence character by character and put the answer in reversed_text tags.
- [agentenv-hf test dataset](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-agentenv-hf-smoke/) (0021 Literacy and numeracy; reward: not stated): Load a greeting into a local sandbox and check it, as the smallest AgentEnv bundle for testing the Hugging Face publishing plugin.
- [Nemotron-RL Instruction Following](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/nvidia-nemotron-rl-instruction-following/) (0021 Literacy and numeracy; reward: programmatic check): Answer WildChat prompts while satisfying an easily verifiable instruction such as staying under 200 words.
- [CHGK and Svoya Igra](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/d0rj-chgk/) (0021 Literacy and numeracy; reward: not stated): Answer Russian quiz questions from the CHGK and Svoya Igra games.
- [Anthroly RL Environment Sample (Synthetic)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/sarathkavuru-anthroly-rl-env-sample/) (0021 Literacy and numeracy; reward: programmatic check): Answer 40 easy synthetic prompts (arithmetic, strings, units, code reasoning) that a short Python grader scores as 0 or 1.
- [twohop-tasks-v1](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/eltociear-twohop-tasks-v1/) (0021 Literacy and numeracy; reward: exact match): Answer 36 multi-hop questions over an in-context synthetic fact set, replying unknown when the answer is not derivable.
- [Echo Environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/space--openenv-echo-env/) (0021 Literacy and numeracy; reward: not stated): Call echo tools and read the echoed message, as a minimal test of the environment API.

## 01 Education

- [Class Test](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/renaissancelabseu-practice-class-test/) (0111 Education science; reward: programmatic check): Analyse a class test as a teacher would: mark answer sheets, run item and distractor analysis, and standardise or moderate the marks.

## 02 Arts and humanities

- [Pool Desk v7 (OpenEnv)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/vibrantlabsai-pool-desk-v7/) (0211 Audio-visual techniques and media production; reward: hidden tests): Retime and convert subtitles, check timecode lists and EDLs, and solve four maths tasks, all as shell tasks verified by pytest.
- [Scribus computer-use environment (REA)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-scribusfromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0211 Audio-visual techniques and media production; reward: programmatic check): Change the headline of a one-page event flyer in Scribus to a new title and save it, leaving the details line unchanged.
- [Inkscape computer-use environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-inkscapecomputerenv-rea/) (0211 Audio-visual techniques and media production; reward: programmatic check): Change a bake sale poster's headline from Spring to Summer with Inkscape's text tool and save the SVG.
- [Inkscape computer-use environment from a one-line request](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-inkscapefromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0211 Audio-visual techniques and media production; reward: programmatic check): Open a poster SVG from Inkscape's Welcome screen, change its headline to Autumn Seed Exchange and save.
- [Pencil2D computer-use environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-pencil2dfromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0211 Audio-visual techniques and media production; reward: programmatic check): Rename the Bitmap Layer to Ball in a bouncing-ball animation in Pencil2D and save.
- [Sigil computer-use environment (REA)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-sigilfromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0211 Audio-visual techniques and media production; reward: programmatic check): Fix a misspelled word in a chapter title of an EPUB in the Sigil editor and save the book, using only the screen, mouse and keyboard.
- [MyPaint computer-use environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-mypaintfromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0213 Fine arts; reward: programmatic check): Rename the Sketch layer to Crescent Moon in a MyPaint drawing and save.
- [MiMo-V2.6-RL Music (Harbor)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/fineenvs-mimo-v2-6-rl-harbor-music/) (0215 Music and performing arts; reward: programmatic check): Compose one piece of music in ABC notation to a written brief.
- [MuseScore 3 computer-use environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-musescorefromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0215 Music and performing arts; reward: programmatic check): Change a score's title to Evening Lullaby and composer to Clara Hollis in MuseScore and save.
- [Rosegarden computer-use environment (REA)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-rosegardenfromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0215 Music and performing arts; reward: programmatic check): Rename the Bass track to Bass Guitar in a Rosegarden music project through the desktop GUI and save it.
- [Hydrogen computer-use environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-hydrogenfromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0215 Music and performing arts; reward: programmatic check): Change a Hydrogen drum-machine song's tempo from 96 to 112 BPM and save it.
- [Harris Matrix](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/renaissancelabseu-practice-harris-matrix/) (0222 History and archaeology; reward: mixed): Work an excavation archive after the dig: order the contexts, reduce the Harris matrix, date deposits from finds and find impossible relations.
- [Argument Check](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/renaissancelabseu-practice-argument-check/) (0223 Philosophy and ethics; reward: mixed): Mark a logic problem sheet: test arguments for validity, sentence sets for consistency and formula pairs for equivalence, with counterexamples and normal forms.
- [Poedit computer-use environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-poeditfromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0231 Language acquisition; reward: programmatic check): Fix a wrong French translation of one message in a gettext .po file in Poedit and save.
- [Parley computer-use environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-parleyfromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0231 Language acquisition; reward: programmatic check): Add the word pair library/biblioteca to a Spanish vocabulary collection in Parley and save.
- [Unslop (Harbor)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/rawmodels-unslop-harbor/) (0232 Literature and linguistics; reward: mixed): Finish a tweet or write a HumanEval function body, graded by a rubric-based LLM judge with a separate length rule; code must pass its tests first.
- [SanskritEnv](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/space--adityahars-sanskrit-env/) (0232 Literature and linguistics; reward: exact match): Resolve structural linguistic ambiguity in Sanskrit manuscript passages across six task layers, from glossary anchoring to full manuscript sessions.

## 03 Social sciences, journalism and information

- [Price Index](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/renaissancelabseu-practice-price-index/) (0311 Economics; reward: programmatic check): Compute an economic statistician's measures from raw tables: price indices, real GDP and chain-linked volumes, inequality and poverty, and inflation contributions.
- [Seat Count](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/renaissancelabseu-practice-seat-count/) (0312 Political sciences and civics; reward: programmatic check): Turn election results into seats: apply thresholds, divisor and quota methods, constituency and levelling seats, and measure disproportionality.
- [Psychometrics](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/renaissancelabseu-practice-psychometrics/) (0313 Psychology; reward: programmatic check): Score questionnaires from a manual, judge reliable change, convert raw scores with norm tables and compute scale reliability, as a psychologist's assistant.
- [Life Table](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/renaissancelabseu-practice-life-table/) (0314 Sociology and cultural studies; reward: programmatic check): Do a demographer's core calculations from population registers: life tables, fertility rates, age-standardised death rates and age-structure indicators.
- [Ghost on AgentEnv (REA)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-ghostenv-rea/) (0321 Journalism and reporting; reward: mixed): Answer factual questions about a seeded Ghost publishing site and make small changes through 36 API tools in a state-backed simulation.
- [ExtractBench](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/llamaindex-extractbench/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: programmatic check): Extract schema-valid JSON from a full PDF document, with correct exhaustive values, nulls for absent data, and a page and bounding box as evidence.
- [ExtractBench Pro](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/llamaindex-extractbenchpro/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: programmatic check): Extract schema-valid JSON from hard synthetic PDFs where values must be read from charts, counted under document rules or decoded with custom terminology.
- [SKBench-Env](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/seekbot-skbench-env/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: programmatic check): Check about ten attributed quotes per task by fetching each source and labelling every claim verbatim or no_match.
- [SKPropagate](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/seekbot-skpropagate-env/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: not stated): Find notes that depend on a corrected note and rule each one stale or clean after an in-place correction.
- [Escalation-safe agent (blocked data tasks)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/ashish-soni08-escalation-safe-agent-data/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: not stated): Fetch one public number from a simulated data provider that may block you, taking only the legitimate route or ending with an honest BLOCKED reason.
- [Tellico computer-use environment (REA)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-tellicofromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: programmatic check): Add a fourth book with given title, author, publisher and year to a Tellico collection and save it through the desktop GUI.
- [JabRef computer-use environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-jabreffromrequestcomputerenv-rea/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: programmatic check): Correct the year of one article in a BibTeX bibliography to 2019 in JabRef and save.
- [BookStack on AgentEnv (REA)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-bookstackenv-rea/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: exact match): Answer factual questions about a seeded BookStack wiki by calling replayed API tools for pages, books, shelves and users.
- [Federal Register API on AgentEnv (REA)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-federalregisterenv-rea/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: exact match): Answer factual questions about US Federal Register documents by calling replayed API tools for documents, facets and suggested searches.
- [Library of Congress photos API (REA replay environment)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-locphotosenv-rea/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: exact match): Answer factual questions about Library of Congress photo records by calling 11 replayed API tools.
- [Art Institute of Chicago API on AgentEnv (REA)](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/earakely-scale-articcollectionenv-rea/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: exact match): Answer factual questions about museum artworks, artists and galleries by calling replayed Art Institute of Chicago API tools.
- [Second Brain Environment](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/space--rac1928-second-brain-env/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: programmatic check): Categorise notes, retrieve the most relevant note from a knowledge base and synthesise answers across notes in three tasks.
- [Form Filling OpenEnv](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/space--tgvarun-form-filling-env/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: exact match): Extract name, age, city and phone from messy, abbreviated or Hinglish user text into structured fields.
- [Agentic RAG Gym](https://practice.renaissancelabs.eu/env/space--williyam-agentic-rag-gym/) (0322 Library, information and archival studies; reward: mixed): Research aerospace and legal questions through multi-agent retrieval, reasoning, critique and verification over a FAISS knowledge base.
